about_the_game:
An explosive tower defense experience like no other.

Step into a vibrant yet savage world where your mission is to protect a colony of crabs from waves of monstrous invaders. In Eldritch Bulwark, strategy meets chaos as you place barricades, deploy specialized warriors, and unleash devastating traps across handcrafted levels teeming with danger.

From blade-wielding surf-mercenaries to explosive powder chests, every decision can turn the tide of battle. Your enemies vary wildly — from armored brutes and ranged bone-throwers to grotesque ducks that multiply upon death, forcing you to adapt constantly.

Key Features:

  • Strategic Tower Defense: Place units, traps, and barricades before each wave begins. Use limited resources wisely.

  • Unique Enemy Types: Face off against diverse foes, each with different behaviors, strengths, and weaknesses.

  • Multiple Levels & Increasing Difficulty: Fight through a series of progressively harder stages. Each level is a tactical puzzle.

  • Resource Management: Earn and spend resources between waves to upgrade defenses or repair damage.

  • Atmospheric Visuals & Sound: Enjoy detailed pixel art, satisfying combat effects, and a tense, immersive soundtrack.

Will you survive the onslaught and keep the crabs safe, or will darkness consume the shore?
